title: C-Mining: Unsupervised Discovery of Seeds for Cultural Data Synthesis via Geometric Misalignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on diverse cultural reasoning benchmarks (CulturalBench-Hard, BLEnD, CultureScope, SAGE) using multiple-choice and true/false questions to test the model's ability to understand specific cultural norms, avoid stereotypes, and resist imposing dominant Western/English-centric perspectives on local scenarios.

Conducting geometric analysis of semantic alignment resistance by measuring the embedding distances between original language terms and their English translations, as well as conducting expert human evaluations across six distinct language spheres (English, German, Japanese, Chinese, French, Spanish).
